AUTO_MERGED.description: inventory is confined to 1:1 and N:1 and offers at least one N:1; the set decides whether N:1 becomes auto-eligible

AUTO_ONE_TO_ONE.description: every selectable candidate is CONTINUED_1_TO_1; the set decides whether 1:1 becomes auto-eligible

HARD_DIAGNOSTIC.description: split, distributed, non-decomposable, mixed and everything else; analysed separately and never an input to the product decision
